description: Set the workspace time zone. The plan’s month and its counts follow it; the answer says from when the change applies.

atSignup.description: Used by the app on a first visit. Leave it out.

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

timeZone.description: A time zone name such as America/Chicago or Europe/Madrid.
